disposition_reason: The original Fig. 3 reward-relative decoder has an ordered score, but its exact published score vector, historical folds, cell-selection privileges and author revision are not recovered. The current chronological post-switch-calibration evaluator changes the original protocol and cannot establish a same-task paper win.

source_paper.title: A flexible hippocampal population code for experience relative to reward

evidence.locator: Fig. 3a–c; Methods, Decoding of RR position
evidence.supports: Original RR decoding target, source cross-validation, occupancy matching and cosine metric; Fig. 3 effect sizes are not raw decoding accuracies.

evidence.locator: Data organization; preprocessing and stochasticity notes
evidence.supports: Author data classes include computed cell classifications and depend on stochastic processing; current main is not a historical publication pin.
Distinct preprocessed and postprocessed releases; postprocessed data already contain RR cell identities; switch days 3,5,7,8,10,12,14.
Historical Fig. 2/3 scope, proposed chronological extension and unresolved author revision.
Current executable scorer uses a prospective chronological split and animal-level summaries, not the published Fig. 3 split.

target.description: Decode circular position relative to reward from CA1 activity, retaining Fig. 3 before-switch and after-switch conditions and RR, TR and non-RR cell panels; Fig. 2 remapping outputs remain calibration.

dataset.description: Author preprocessed Figshare 27098065 and postprocessed 27138633 are identified, but exact immutable files and Fig. 3 sample mapping remain unadmitted. The registered DANDI version differs from the current author download route.

cohort.description: Fig. 3 includes 11 switching mice over seven switch days, 77 sessions; smaller animal/session subsets cannot substitute.

split.description: Paper specifies tenfold 90/10 fitting before the switch, testing before or after, and last 30 post-switch trials for matched support. Exact realized folds and occupancy sample indices remain absent; chronological half-session calibration is an extension.

inputs.description: Deconvolved calcium event time series for each original cell subpopulation. Historical retrospective RR classification must be reproduced and disclosed; any train-only classification changes need a separately labelled comparison.

preprocessing.description: Source speed threshold is >2 cm/s and occupancy matching uses 45 circular bins. Exact position/reward alignment, teleport treatment, stochastic classifications and downsampling realization still need binding.

metric.description: Per-sample score cos(theta_RR - theta_hat_RR), higher is better; Fig. 3b compares session means with shuffle means. Effect size 2.7 for post-switch RR is not a cosine score.

aggregation.description: Fig. 3b averages time samples and cross-validation folds within session; Fig. 3c uses session-shuffle z-scores and animal averages. These remain distinct endpoints.

comparison.primary_metric: Fig. 3b session-level mean cosine RR decoding score, retaining every source condition

published_baseline.description: No exact published session score vector or declared headline aggregation has been recovered; do not use the reported standardized effect sizes as scores.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: The author circular-linear route exists, but no authenticated historical rerun or fold/data receipt exists.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful gain in cosine units must be justified from the original score distribution and stochastic replay variation; no numeric margin is inferred from significance.

uncertainty.method: Resolve paired mouse-level inference and multiplicity across the original before/after and cell-population panels before any final evaluation.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Mouse (11), with all seven sessions retained together
uncertainty.rationale: The independent biological units must be preserved; source significance tests and repeated folds are not a predeclared method-superiority rule.

paper_win_requires: Recover the exact Fig. 3 source scores and source-authorized rerun, including original 11 mice and seven switch days.
Match original targets, retrospective cell memberships, occupancy samples, folds, inputs and preprocessing privileges for candidate and author comparator.
Beat the published result and the verified author rerun on the same admitted endpoint with a task-specific meaningful-effect and uncertainty rule.
Report every original condition; no larger standardized effect against shuffle, chronological split score, or reduced cohort is a paper win.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison has been independently verified; surpassing an author rerun and surpassing the published result remain separate claims.

episode.improvement_loop: Admission is blocked. After source recovery, allow iteration using only declared source training/validation feedback; the existing chronological episode remains an explicitly separate extension.
episode.candidate_freeze: Before final scoring, freeze method, original fold/sample mapping, cell memberships, preprocessing access, comparison panel, effect rule, uncertainty procedure and concrete resource/access ceilings.
episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate the frozen candidate and independently rerun author method on the original Fig. 3 support without adaptive final-score feedback. Current evaluator cannot certify this.
episode.baseline_policy: Published Fig. 3 scores, independently rerun author scores and the local chronological comparator are distinct; none may stand in for another. Where the original method defines stochastic sampling, a source-supported protocol-equivalent rerun with recorded new random state, calibration tolerance and paired candidate/reference support is admissible; historical RNG state is not an independent prerequisite. This does not authorize changed sampling rules, population, input privilege or endpoint.

blocking_issues: Exact published Fig. 3 score artifacts and source historical code revision are not bound.
Original cross-validation/downsampling realization and classification access privileges remain unresolved.
Current scorer implements a new split and cannot emit a same-task victory.
Meaningful effect, valid uncertainty, finite access/resource budgets and a source-protocol evaluator remain unadmitted.

legacy.notes: Preserve full Fig. 2/3 reconstruction and chronological extension artifacts as calibration or labelled extension only; cosine arithmetic alone does not establish stronger-than-paper performance.
